config.craftlatro.title: Craftlatro Settings
config.craftlatro.category.balatro.descr: How Balatro is shown and which installation it runs.
config.craftlatro.category.performance.d: The levers that decide how much the embedded browser costs. The largest is the render scale.
config.craftlatro.windowMode.tooltip: Windowed leaves the 3D world visible around the game: drag the title bar to move it and drag any edge to resize it. Full screen covers the whole viewport. Changes apply the next time the Balatro window opens.
config.craftlatro.worldRunning.tooltip: Whether the world keeps ticking while the Balatro window is open, so it stays a picture-in-picture over a living world. The window captures all input, so a running world can hurt you while you cannot react; turn it off for the pause a normal screen causes. In multiplayer the world always keeps running.
config.craftlatro.backgroundBlur: Blur the world behind the window
config.craftlatro.backgroundBlur.tooltip: Whether the world behind the Balatro window is blurred, the way a normal Minecraft screen blurs it. Off leaves the world sharp and fully visible, which is the point of the windowed mode. Applies straight away.
config.craftlatro.aspectLocked.tooltip: Keeps the window at 16:9 while you drag any edge. Hold shift during a drag to size it freely for that drag.
config.craftlatro.gamePath: The Balatro installation is changed with /craftlatro pick (or F9). The browser session is rebuilt automatically when the package changes, and the settings here never invalidate a running game.
config.craftlatro.commands: Every command still works alongside this screen: /craftlatro open, pick, load, warn, render, fps, stats, reload, save export, save import and save list.
config.craftlatro.experimental: love.js is a port of Balatro, not Balatro: RNG, shaders and audio can differ, so seed parity with the PC release is not guaranteed.
config.craftlatro.renderScale.tooltip: Fraction of the scaled screen the browser actually paints. Lower is faster and costs sharpness. Applies to an open window straight away, otherwise on the next open.
config.craftlatro.frameRate.tooltip: How often the browser repaints into its surface, in frames per second. Unset it follows Minecraft's frame rate; moving this slider pins it. Paint faster than Minecraft composites is discarded work.
config.craftlatro.statsOverlay.tooltip: Shows paint rate, surface size, Chromium paint millis and memory in the corner of the Balatro window.
